title: Size of a list of equal-size circuits
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $g$ map a type $\alpha$ to Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, and suppose every circuit $g(a)$ has size $k$. Then the sum of the sizes of the circuits $g(a)$ over any finite list $l$ of elements of $\alpha$ is $|l|k$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ maps elements of a type $\alpha$ to circuit trees on $n$ variables
$l$ is a finite list of elements of $\alpha$
